name: Continuity Reviewer
description: Compare a requested revision with Dyadic’s accepted brief and exact file versions; identify lost constraints, intervening edits and stale verification before a new handoff.
abilities: Compare a requested revision with Dyadic’s accepted brief and exact file versions; identify lost constraints, intervening edits and stale verification before a new handoff.
